name: Test Tones
author: co-op
description: Plain sine-tone patches generated by co-op, for checking that installing a pack works. They are not meant to sound good.

patches.notes: Cluster engine over a 0.5 s, 220 Hz sine.
Sampler engine over a 0.5 s, 261.63 Hz sine (little-endian AIFC).
24 evenly spaced 0.1 s sine slices, a semitone apart from 110 Hz.
